brief: Clear the obstructed ventilation on Briarcliff Bend before the heat event, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity when a unit is identified for pre-event attention (SOP-011). Because the unit has an oil issue and is aged 41 years, prioritize it for attention ahead of younger units in similar condition (MG-023). If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
